content.text: Digital creators often face significant challenges when trying to sell products online, especially in regions where platforms like PayPal, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-honest-side-side-breakdown-12|COREMERCH guide to stripe]], or Gumroad are unavailable or impose hefty fees. For instance, you may be in a country where conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-honest-side-side-3|Payment Options]]-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-broken-here-infrastructure|payment]] methods are restricted, leaving you without an effective way to monetize your work. This post breaks down how to utilize Solana for payments on digital products, offering a robust infrastructure that eliminates the need for restrictive platforms and drastically reduces transaction fees.

For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators-4. content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Understanding Solana payments is crucial for digital creators looking to sell products like ebooks, courses, or templates without relying on conventional payment platforms. Solana is a high-performance blockchain that enables fast and low-cost transactions. This matters because traditional services charge hefty fees, like Gumroad's 10% per sale. In contrast, Solana's payment infrastructure, through tools like NOWPayments, only charges 0.5%. By leveraging this, creators can retain more earnings and have complete control over their transactions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the Solana payment system relies on smart contracts and decentralized finance (DeFi) principles. When a customer purchases a digital product, the payment is processed on-chain, ensuring security and transparency. The transaction is immediately confirmed, which triggers an automatic delivery of the product, facilitated by tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This architecture not only speeds up the transaction process but also allows for real-time conversion of crypto to USD, making it accessible for creators and customers alike.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is designed for digital creators in regions where access to mainstream payment platforms is limited or non-existent. It serves authors, educators, designers, and software developers who produce digital products but find traditional payment processing options either unavailable or cost-prohibitive. By utilizing Solana, these creators can sell their work directly to customers globally, maintaining control over their sales and maximizing their profit margins.
Reduce transaction fees from 10% to 0.5% with Solana payments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effectiveness of this payment system comes from various components working in harmony. Tools like NOWPayments facilitate crypto payment processing, while platforms like Cloudflare provide the hosting and backend logic needed for order management and product delivery. Additionally, using solutions like Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage allows for seamless integration and data ownership, giving creators complete control over their sales without relying on third-party platforms.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this payment infrastructure, first, choose your digital products to sell. Next, select your stack based on the components discussed, such as Cloudflare Workers for backend logic and NOWPayments for crypto processing. Follow deployment guides to set up your order storage and file delivery systems. Once everything is connected, test the payment process to ensure smooth delivery. Finally, promote your digital store to start generating sales. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all the blueprints and templates you need for a successful deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe can be done effectively by using Solana for payment processing. By leveraging NOWPayments, you can accept crypto payments directly, which eliminates platform fees and allows for seamless product delivery. This setup empowers you to keep a larger share of your sales revenue.
Own your entire digital commerce stack without platform dependencies.

If you're looking to sell digital downloads while avoiding hefty platform fees, exploring Solana payments is an excellent option. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers everything you need to establish your sovereign digital commerce stack, enabling you to sell without restrictions. Check it out at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Identify your digital product to sell and its pricing. Select the right tools, such as Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments, for your stack. Configure your order management system with Supabase or Google Sheets. Set up your file delivery method, using services like Google Drive. Test the entire purchasing process to ensure functionality. Launch your digital store and promote it to attract customers.
